card.name: Rhetorical questions and emphatic asides
card.fires_on: Words inside rhetorical or exclamatory phrasing in general prose, especially the start of a quoted question like "How in the world". It also fires on short emphatic openers such as And, Sure and because.

modes.label: Rhetorical question
modes.description: Words in a quoted, incredulous question such as "How in the world can...".
modes.example: They reason, "<<How>> in the world can an object be moving

modes.description: Short connecting or affirming words in conversational or argumentative sentences.
